title: Google uploaded display specifications
scope: Fixed image sizes, 150 KB cap and regional image inventory; separate from HTML5.

title: Google responsive display specifications
scope: Native fields and image assets; 90-character description maximum.

title: Google responsive display creative guide
scope: Avoid added text/logo/buttons on responsive image assets; not a blanket prohibition on complete uploaded ads. Its 80-character descriptive advice differs from the technical maximum.

title: Google Demand Gen specifications
scope: At least one headline at 30 characters or fewer is now called out for Display serving/ad strength.

title: Google Performance Max specifications
scope: At least one short headline of 15 characters or fewer; publisher weighting for double-width languages.

title: LinkedIn single image ads
scope: Landscape and square across desktop/mobile; portrait is mobile-only; native copy separate.

title: LinkedIn carousel ads
scope: Square cards, 2–10 cards, per-card/native fields distinct. Studio 2–6 is an operational limit.

title: LinkedIn document ads
scope: Document and native text limits; links only clickable after download. Raster proof is not accessible document delivery.

title: Pinterest creative guidance
scope: Product focus, vertical composition, concise overlays; native fields separate.

title: Pinterest advertising specifications
scope: Desktop/in-app file caps and native fields. Background appearance can change in light/dark feeds.

title: X creative specifications
scope: Native weighted text and image assets; expanded aspect-ratio options do not establish a typography minimum.

title: Reddit image ad specifications
scope: Feed versus conversation thumbnail; native maximum differs from truncation recommendation.

title: TikTok Ad Network image specifications
scope: Network image sizes/caps and banner assets; not interchangeable with TikTok feed image carousel.

title: TikTok Reservation Takeover
scope: Reservation workflow; a still fallback is not a complete campaign.

title: Snapchat format overview
scope: Current overview lists 720×1280 for single image/video; deeper eligibility depends on format and account.

title: Snapchat detailed single image specifications
scope: Detailed help content was not readable in web extraction; do not certify exact safe-zone or file-cap changes.

title: Meta Instagram Story image guide
scope: Redirected to login; numerical safe-zone claims from third-party sites were not adopted.

title: Apple notification guidance
scope: JavaScript shell only in extraction; current detailed content not reverified.

title: Android notification design
scope: Native collapsed/expanded layouts and concise text recommendations, not an arbitrary image font size.

title: WHATWG Notifications standard
scope: Browser native options; no universal rendered character capacity across agents.

title: Google Merchant image link requirements
scope: Clean exact product primary image; no added promotions or logo overlays. Effective-date size ambiguity remains separate.

title: Shopify product media
scope: Theme controls rendered size and crop; upload maximum is not visible reading size.

title: YouTube custom thumbnails
scope: 3840×2160 recommended video image; device-specific file caps; minimum width 640 is distinct.

title: Responsive images
scope: Resource pixels, display width and pixel density are separate.

title: Mailchimp image design
scope: Image crop, image-off fallback and live message. Legacy client examples do not establish 2026 client behavior universally.

title: Mailchimp mobile design
scope: 16 px mobile body guidance. Old device examples are not a universal viewport specification.

title: W3C contrast explanation
scope: 4.5:1/3:1 with delivered-size thresholds and exceptions; not a universal ad-upload rule.

title: W3C Images tutorial
scope: Meaningful text alternatives and live-text treatment; a flat PNG cannot certify full accessibility.

title: GOV.UK accessible publishing
scope: 12 pt minimum guidance for documents; scope differs from vendor printability.

title: GOV.UK accessible communication formats
scope: Consider 14 pt for readers with sight loss; alternative formats matter.

title: MOO flyer production
scope: 8 pt production floor, vector PDF and 300 dpi photos; not universal comfort or another printer template.

title: VistaPrint flyer design
scope: Hierarchy, grouped details, finishing and production checks. Examples can still have small essential text.

title: OAAA creative best practices
scope: 2021 guide pages 24–29: distance, dwell time, seven-word benchmark and context. It describes suggestions, not operator approval law.

title: OAAA published billboard examples
scope: 2019 historical campaigns demonstrate hierarchy; no campaign performance claim or brand-style transfer.
